summary: Iter33 - Verified (A) Gallery Drive preview fix and (B) MeetingChat full-conversation panel + voice tool link cards. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter33.py: POST /api/realtime/calls/{id}/transcript accepts default via='realtime' and via='meeting_chat'; via='bogus' returns 422; GET /api/conversations/{cid}/messages returns the inserted messages carrying the correct `via` field (realtime + meeting_chat), and the meeting_chat assistant message contains the markdown link with docs.google.com; POST /api/realtime/calls/{id}/end {elapsed_seconds:0} returns 200. Also verified gallery drive_items shape: all drive items for the Google-connected user have a docs.google.com `link` and no `path`. Frontend (Playwright, Google user via minted JWT in localStorage aivora_token): /gallery renders 4 drive cards (data-testid gallery-item-drive); opening 'Uji Oryntix Doc' opens gallery-preview; preview contains only one anchor with href=https://docs.google.com/document/d/.../edit (preview-open-drive), preview-drive-info is visible with 'Tersimpan di Google Drive Anda' copy, and NO anchor with '/api/files/undefined' is present; preview-dl-file and preview-share are correctly absent. Non-drive card test skipped because this user's gallery contains only drive items (expected for a Drive-connected account). MeetingChatPanel in-call UI not driven live (realtime call requires microphone negotiation + OpenAI credit burn — explicitly marked best-effort in the review); instead verified via API that both via='realtime' and via='meeting_chat' messages persist to the conversation and are returned by /conversations/{cid}/messages. Source review of /app/frontend/src/components/MeetingChatPanel.jsx confirmed `items = messages` (whole conversation rendered), isVoice -> mc-voice-badge, Bubble emits mc-msg-user/mc-msg-assistant for every message regardless of `via`. Pre-test setup: topped up demo@aivora.ai credits to 50000 in Mongo (as instructed) so /realtime/calls could be created.
critical_code_review_comments: GalleryPreview.jsx correctly short-circuits for kind==='drive': renders preview-open-drive (anchor to item.link), preview-drive-info card, and hides preview-dl-file + preview-share. No regressions for other kinds (document still renders dl-docx/dl-pdf; image/video still render fileUrl(item.path); non-drive still shows preview-share).

realtime_voice.TranscriptIn.via Field pattern '^(realtime|meeting_chat)$' correctly rejects invalid values with 422; default 'realtime' is applied when the field is omitted. Message document correctly stores `via` for both roles.
MeetingChatPanel renders the ENTIRE conversation (items = messages), so historical and future voice transcripts both appear. The mc-voice-badge is rendered only when m.via === 'realtime'. Good.
